$comment: C-30 sentinel baseline (T1.16). Six base scenes spread across the corpus: primitives, glTF PBR, skinning, shadows, HDRI IBL and instancing — the highest-coverage canaries for flag-off identity checks (CONTRACTS §6.1). Captured flag-off twice from main for the IC-0 noise comparison.
$doc: IC-0 tolerance: computed by metrics.py as deltaE2000 p99 across the pairwise flag-off repeat captures (same commit, fresh browser contexts, no spec edits). The tolerance lands with the first IC-0 run — it is measured, never assumed; until then `identityCheck.deltaE2000P99` stays null and the gate must not read it.
